name: mimo-first-bridge
description: Xiaomi MiMo bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): dispatch to MiMoCode (`mimo` CLI) or the Xiaomi MiMo Desktop client, preselected in settings (backend = mimocode | mimo-desktop). Full DSH control on the CLI path (--dangerously-skip-permissions), Desktop local API on the desktop path, rate-limit/network fallback dialog, live status light, and a zero-dependency MCP server (mimo_run / mimo_continue / mimo_status / mimo_settings).

scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --check && node scripts/verify.mjs && node mcp/mimo-mcp-server.mjs --check
scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs --check && node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/desktop-delivery.test.mjs && node tests/indicator-stale.test.mjs && node tests/contracts.test.mjs && node tests/mcp-smoke.test.mjs
